breaks.Production_or_Business_Consequence: Partitioning can add design, testing, reporting and administration cost.

breaks.Cost_Consequence: May require a different platform, data-handling redesign or duplicated controls.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Load a production-representative topology with peak concurrent agents, contacts, queue depth, callbacks, transfers and supervisor views across the proposed Contact Center partitioning.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Load logs, routing traces, queue metrics, reporting/WFM results, support escalation record.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any silent loss, unacceptable fragmentation, queue/object ceiling or recovery behavior that changes the buyer operating model.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: At what tested scale did the deployment require Contact Center/queue partitioning, and what changed operationally?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer peak-volume model, test tenants, representative routing/WFM/reporting configuration.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Documented per-object/queue limits may force topology partitioning at buyer scale.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No dropped/misrouted contacts; routing priority, callbacks, reporting, supervisor and WFM scope remain correct; recovery after overload is demonstrated.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Map every in-scope data class-metadata, recordings, transcripts, AI data, logs, backups and support access-to storage/processing geography.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Architecture diagram, DPA/BAA, subprocessor list, contract language, data-flow evidence.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any mandatory permanent-data class remains in a prohibited geography or uncontrolled support/subprocessor path.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which permanent and transient data classes can be guaranteed to stay in the required jurisdiction, including backups and support access?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer data-classification and residency requirements plus Dialpad contractual architecture.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Strict residency may conflict with documented US permanent-data storage.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All mandatory data classes meet buyer location/access rules contractually and technically.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Administer and change Webchat, SMS, Email, WhatsApp and one social channel plus WFM schedule/API in the proposed state, then simulate a channel/integration failure.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Change log, admin screenshots, incident timeline, support RACI, rollback evidence.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Hidden legacy dependency, inconsistent configuration, unclear support owner or material regression without recovery.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: How many admin/control surfaces will remain after implementation, and who owns each one during an incident?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative current and migrated digital configurations, WFM integration, named admins.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Mixed digital/WFM administration can create operational fragmentation.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Admin owners can make/test changes, identify authoritative surface, diagnose failure and recover without ambiguous ownership.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Execute a consequential action with wrong identity, stale data, connector timeout, duplicate request, partial backend success and policy exception.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Agent transcript, tool/action logs, application transaction IDs, rollback/compensation evidence, human-handoff record.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any silent/duplicate/unauthorized action, unrecoverable partial state or missing audit evidence.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Show a failed action end to end-including what the customer sees, what the system of record contains and how the operation is repaired.
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Sandbox systems of record, test identities, realistic permissions, reversible transactions.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Agentic actions are not decision-grade until identity, duplicate execution, partial success and recovery are proven.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Unauthorized actions are blocked; duplicates are idempotent; partial failures are detected; required confirmations occur; audit/recovery is complete.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Create two clients with shared agents; isolate routing, recordings, reporting, WFM/QM, knowledge, AI, integrations, admins and usage; inject a misconfiguration in one client.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Access tests, reports, recordings, usage exports, incident logs and client-specific admin views.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Cross-client visibility, policy bleed, shared blast radius, pooled-agent friction or unusable chargeback.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Can a shared agent serve two clients without exposing data, knowledge, quality policy, AI context or usage across them?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Two realistic client datasets, shared agents, separate policies/integrations/knowledge and chargeback tags.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: General Contact Center segmentation does not prove multi-client BPO isolation.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: No cross-client data/policy leakage; program-specific reporting/WEM/AI is correct; failure remains contained; usage can be attributed.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Quote and run a representative service/collections campaign for the actual Dialer user population and outbound volume.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Quote, invoice simulation, campaign usage report and unit-cost calculation.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Hidden SKU/credit requirements or unit economics exceed buyer threshold.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What is the fully loaded incremental cost per Dialer-enabled agent and per successful outbound contact?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Named/concurrent agent counts, campaign volume, destination mix, attempt rules and seasonality.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Dialer licensing can materially change blended contact-center economics.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All required Sell Premium licenses, credits and telephony costs are explicit and reconcile to an agreed unit-cost model.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Recreate top five production routing scenarios including priority queues, transfer, callback, voicemail and closed/no-agent states.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Call traces, queue events, supervisor views and fallback outcomes.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Any unreachable state, priority inversion or lost context.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which routing states cannot be reproduced without Expert Workflows or custom services?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer routing decision table and test calls.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Routing breadth must work with buyer skills, priorities and failure paths.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Every path routes deterministically with correct priority, context and fallback.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Test webchat, SMS, email and one social/messaging channel from automation through live-agent escalation and follow-up.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Conversation logs, transcript, agent UI, routing events.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Context loss, duplicate conversation, routing mismatch or unsupported channel behavior.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What context is lost when moving from self-service to an agent or between digital channels?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative identities, attachments, prior history and routing rules.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Digital breadth only matters if identity/context survives channel and human handoff.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Customer identity, transcript/history, intent and routing context survive handoff; agent can resolve without re-entry.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Load historical voice/email/chat data, create queues, generate forecast, schedule shifts, simulate intraday change and measure adherence.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Forecast outputs, staffing requirements, schedule, intraday change log.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Required work type cannot be represented or admin effort is disproportionate.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which workload types and queue structures require manual workarounds?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: 12+ weeks history, buyer SLAs, skills, shrinkage and schedule rules.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: WFM depth has changed materially since Phase 1 and must be tested on buyer workload.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Forecast/schedule workflow is usable, explainable and supports required workload granularity and intraday changes.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Run a buyer-curated voice and digital truth set through scorecards and supervisor review/appeal.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Score distributions, disagreement analysis, reviewer changes, digital grades.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unacceptable agreement, no review path or digital automation assumed but unavailable.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What QA functions differ today between voice and digital interactions?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Known-good/known-bad interactions, rubric, human ground-truth graders.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Voice AI QA and digital manual/EAP maturity differ.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Voice AI scores are explainable and reviewable; digital workflow meets current buyer requirements without relying on unavailable AI grading.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Break a business-critical CRM/integration dependency and run the incident through monitoring, ownership, escalation and recovery.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Alert/log timeline, tickets, API errors, recovered records.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Silent failure, ownership ping-pong or data inconsistency after recovery.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Who owns the incident when Dialpad is healthy but the customer workflow is broken?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Production-like integration, support contacts, logs and failure injection.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Publisher-dependent support can create incident ambiguity.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Failure is detected quickly, owner is unambiguous, degraded behavior is acceptable and data recovers correctly.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Export recordings/transcripts/analytics for a representative historical period and verify format, completeness, metadata and automation path.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Export files, APIs, metadata reconciliation, timing.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Data is retained but inaccessible, incomplete or dependent on manual/vendor intervention beyond buyer tolerance.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: What historical data becomes harder to access after the plan's normal access window?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Representative retained data older than normal portal window where applicable.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Retention is not the same as access or exitability.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Buyer can retrieve required data in usable format within exit/RTO requirements.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Modify routing, a digital workflow, an integration and an AI Agent in a controlled test, validate before/after behavior and perform rollback/recovery.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Change history, test results, rollback logs and approvals.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Change directly harms production without safe validation/rollback or audit.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which changes can be promoted from isolated test to production, and which are edited directly in the live control plane?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Non-production/test scope, regression suite, named owner.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Enterprise promotion/rollback controls are not fully public.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Changes can be validated before broad impact; rollback/recovery is deterministic; audit identifies who changed what.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Validate every target country's number availability, emergency services, port eligibility, outbound presentation, failover and cutover timing.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Country matrix, port approvals, test calls, failover tests.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Unsupported numbering/emergency/porting requirement or unacceptable migration risk.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which countries or number types require a different carrier/architecture or materially longer lead time?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Country/number inventory and current carrier records.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: International numbering and porting vary by country/carrier.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: All countries meet service, regulatory and cutover requirements with accepted lead times.

proof_requirements.Buyer_Controlled_Scenario: Model 12 months with seasonal peak, AI Agent growth, international minutes, Dialer campaigns, WFM/QA add-ons and retention/export needs.
proof_requirements.Evidence_to_Capture: Three-scenario TCO model, quote assumptions, usage reports.
proof_requirements.Failure_Criterion: Cost exceeds threshold or important usage driver cannot be forecast/controlled.
proof_requirements.Reference_Call_Question: Which consumption driver creates the largest variance between base and peak years?
proof_requirements.Required_Test_Data_or_Preconditions: Buyer interaction volumes, geographies, seasonality, automation assumptions and quote.
proof_requirements.Risk_or_Hypothesis: Seat pricing alone can understate run-state cost as telephony, AI and outbound usage grows.
proof_requirements.Success_Criterion: Total cost stays within threshold under base/peak/high-AI scenarios and all metered drivers are measurable.
